Mods are small JavaScript or TypeScript files that you run within your Claude Code session. They allow you to react to events, modify the behavior of Claude Code or render your own interfaces in both the terminal and desktop applications. Here's a nice ~3m video on mods by Lydia: What I love most about mods is that they can be created without learning their API. Run claude and describe the mod you want it to create. items.title: Google将AI搜索广告扩展至全球更多市场 试图将AI变为新增长引擎

items.description: IT之家 10 月 29 日现场消息，ISHO 今日宜休 AI 睡眠科技生态产品发布会已告一段落。今日宜休科技公司创始人王腾今晚发布了 ISHO Ring / ISHO Ring Pro 智能戒指和 ISHO iFlow 智能温控系统 / iFlow 智能温控系统 Pro。 王腾今日还发布了行业首套弹性调休方案 ——「好状态」计划： 当员工精力指数低于 60 分，可以自主申请调休 ，对接飞书 MCP 实现自动请假（每季度不超过 10 次）。 IT之家注意到，「好状态」计划面向全行业开放落地， 提供企业专属优惠、专属团队支持 ，专人协助完成 MCP 调试。王腾称，好的工作不应以牺牲睡眠和健康为代价，欢迎更多企业加入，一起提升团队幸福感。

items.title: 借钱搞 AI：消息称微软计划通过美国债券发行至少筹资 250 亿美元
items.description: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，据彭博社报道，微软公司计划发行美国投资级债券，至少募资 250 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,670.13 亿元人民币） ，这是该公司时隔九年多首次开展这类债券发行。和同行企业一样，微软借债是为了给人工智能领域的大规模投入提供资金。 知情人士透露，目前尚未最终确定此次发行的规模，具体金额可能根据市场需求进行调整。 这位知情人士表示，这家全球最大的软件公司计划将此次债券发行分为最多 10 个期限档次，期限从 2 年到 40 年不等。 该人士补充，期限最长、2066 年到期的债券，初始定价区间为比美国国债收益率最高溢价 1.35 个百分点。 富国银行、摩根大通以及瑞银集团担任本次债券发行的承销商。募集资金将用于一般企业用途，包括资本开支。 这笔债券发行，结束了微软长期的发债空白期。彭博汇总数据显示，微软是仅有的两家同时获得穆迪和标普最高 AAA 评级的美国上市公司之一，另一家是强生公司；该公司上一次发行高等级债券是在 2017 年，当时分 7 档发行，募资 170 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,135.69 亿元人民币） 。 自 Alphabet 公司

items.title: 实测即梦短剧工作室，这可能是 Seedance 2.5 最有性价比的用法
items.description: 给创作者好的工具，他们就能做出精彩的作品 #欢迎关注爱范儿官方微信公众号：爱范儿（微信号：ifanr），更多精彩内容第一时间为您奉上。
items.author: 张子豪
items.content: 随着视频模型的进步，越来越多创作者开始尝试更复杂的内容。从最初的一条视频，到完整的短片、商业广告，再到有连续剧情和多个角色的剧集，AI 视频创作能够完成的作品也越来越丰富。 几十甚至上百个镜头，如何保证人物形象、服装和场景的一致性？修改一段剧情，能不能同步调整后面的分镜？已经生成的视频，如果只有几秒钟不满意，还需要全部重新生成吗？ 从剧本创作、角色和场景资产管理，到 3D 导演台、智能预演、片段重拍以及超分等功能，即梦把这些工具放进了一套完整的创作流程中。 这次，即梦短剧工作室也整合了小云雀短剧 Agent 的部分能力，将此前探索的短剧工作流与即梦的模型、视频生成能力进一步衔接。在此基础上，即梦还加入了自研剧本模型 DreamScript，提供更完整的剧本解析、资产管理和 3D 导演台等功能。 即梦短剧工作室提供了三种进入方式：只有一句话灵感，可以从原创剧本开始；已经有小说或其他 IP，可以进行短剧改编；已经有完整剧本，也可以直接上传，继续完成后续的资产解析和分镜制作。 我们把自己当做完全没有想法，但是又想创作自己的短剧用户，选择了其中的原创剧本，使用即梦自研剧本模型 DreamScript 来创作。

The voice AI sector is hot, and top players are trying to consolidate their position as more business models come to the fore through partnerships and acquisitions. Deepgram is the latest to make such moves: The company said on Thursday that it is acquiring Daily, the maker and maintainer of one of the most popular open-source voice AI infrastructures, Pipecat. The companies didn’t disclose the deal amount but said that they will keep Pipecat open-source. For the uninitiated, Pipecat is a framework that manages voice and video streams along with other pieces in the pipeline, like speech-to-text (STT), large language models, and text-to-speech (TTS) models while reducing latency. Its maker, Daily, provides hosted infrastructure for voice and video calls of any kind. With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure.

Microsoft has never disclosed Azure’s quarterly revenue in dollars. It has typically only shared a growth percentage or described revenue dollar milestones in vague ways. But on Wednesday, when it posted another record-breaking quarter , it reported that Azure brought in a healthy $33.2 billion in revenue for the July-September quarter, up 48% from a year earlier. The disclosure lets investors line up Azure’s performance more directly against Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud, whose parent companies already report cloud revenue in dollars every quarter. Alphabet, which also reported earnings on Wednesday, said Google Cloud brought in $30.7 billion in the same quarter, putting Azure slightly ahead. But Google Cloud, which also includes Google’s Workspace subscriptions, roughly doubled its revenue from a year earlier, growing about twice as fast as Azure, according to TechCrunch’s calculations. Azure, where businesses rent computing power to run applications, SaaS, and to build and run AI models, is now Microsoft’s largest and fastest-growing product line by the company’s own figures. It accounted for roughly 36% of Microsoft’s $92.3 billion in quarterly revenue.

Google’s Chrome browser is getting an update that will improve its autofill capabilities using AI. On Wednesday, the company said that Chrome will get an advanced version of autofill that will help users fill out online forms with suggestions pulled from their Gmail. That means Chrome could suggest things you might need to know, like a flight confirmation number, membership ID, tracking information, order number, address, phone number, or credit card number by referencing your email. The update is an expansion of Google’s Personal Intelligence, which already allows users to connect their Google Apps to its AI assistant, Gemini, to retrieve certain details and then use them to answer complex questions. Though seemingly minor, the update could make Chrome easier to use, which could give users another reason to continue to use Google’s browser and stay in its AI ecosystem. It’s reminiscent of one of Apple’s most appreciated features: the ability to automatically detect verification codes sent via text and display them above the keyboard, allowing users to enter them with a single tap.
